title: use dev and use opt exit 1 on a shadowed link having pointed it, which the help page does not say: the page and the message say so (not in 0.1.16)
body:
`devbin use dev` and `use opt` point the link and then exit 1 when it is shadowed, and nothing documented says so. On 2026-10-27 at 15:45:41Z (intent-dc's read, AC-05.3's opt leg), `bin/devbin use opt` run from a session whose PATH had Homebrew's bin ahead of `~/.local/bin` wrote `~/.local/bin/devbin`, printed the tree line, then "the link /Users/matts/.local/bin/devbin is shadowed: the first devbin on PATH is /opt/homebrew/bin/devbin", and exited 1. The link stayed, so the machine was on opt with the command having failed. A wrapper's trap put it back at brew two seconds later. On main, lib/cmd/use's last three steps for dev and opt are `_use_point`, `_use_report` and `_use_shadowed || return 1`. lib/pages/use.md says only "A bare `use`, and `doctor`, fail when the link is not the first `devbin` on PATH", and `docs/dev-opt-brew.md` T5's shadow check names doctor and a bare `use` alone. Filed by vc on 2026-10-27; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Fix

The as-built behaviour is kept: the link is the switch, a person whose shell shadows it needs telling at once, and a non-zero exit is how a script hears it. The help page says so, in the sentence about the shadow check: `use dev` and `use opt` run the same check after pointing the link, and exit 1 when it is shadowed, with the link left pointed and named, so a person either fixes PATH or runs `use brew`. The refusal's own wording says the link was pointed, so a reader does not take the exit for "nothing changed". T5 is the contract's, so any change to its sentence is an amendment for the signatories (molt-vc, utilz-vc, intent-vc, gtools-vc). devbin's help page is devbin's alone.

## Done when

1. lib/pages/use.md says that `use dev` and `use opt` exit 1 on a shadowed link, leaving it pointed, and the shadow message says the link was pointed. An arm in use.bats holds both: run under a PATH that shadows the link, the exit is 1, the link names the tree, and the output says the link was pointed and what shadows it.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

- use dev and use opt on a shadowed link keep the as-built exit 1 and say that they pointed the link and it stays pointed, then the shadow line, then to fix PATH as that says or run use brew. A bare use's refusal is unchanged. lib/pages/use.md's shadow-check paragraph says so; T5 of docs/dev-opt-brew.md is untouched.
- Landed on main: `79f5da0c`.
- Arm: use.bats, use dev and use opt under a PATH that shadows the link: exit 1, the link naming the tree, and the output saying it was pointed and what shadows it.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run 20261029-1314, 2826 counted, ran every arm above ok.
- Run 20261029-1336 (`--failed`) ran that run's two reds, neither in this issue's arms, ok at their fixes, 2 of 2, so main at 5085ae24 is green.
